tests.name: Canonical identities, source-backed evidence labels, stable hashes and metadata reconstruction
Real file upload, partial batch errors, duplicate contents, SHA-256 and safe CSV/text preview
Empty, oversized, disguised, binary-text and invalid Office uploads are rejected
Sequential independent review and explicit typed sign-off; one shared Work item; immutable receipts
Requester and file contributor cannot be assigned to approve their own submission
Replacement supersedes pending approval without retargeting earlier document links
Pinned attachments retain their version-specific approval instead of inheriting the latest state
Session-only byte loss remains explicit and blocks approval after metadata reconstruction
Assessment uploads and evidence review use the same file version without auto-approving compliance
Scope, search and exports use the same query; cross-location links fail validation
Form evidence fields use a controlled document picker and submitted response links are locked
Published report output is saved as a versioned document without changing its source snapshot
Change requests, rejection and withdrawal retain prior decisions and separate request episodes
Changed approval snapshots and repeated approval attempts cannot create accepted decisions
Folder moves and archive/restore preserve file versions, source links and completed reviews
Custom form submissions feed canonical requirement evaluations, independent review and shared Work
Technical source uncertainty and heuristics cannot silently produce satisfied requirements
Assessment-to-requirement bridge rejects cross-target sources and changed submitted snapshots
Document explorer, previews, version history and populated approval/upload flows at four widths
